title: Support --name=value in the argument parser
statement: The deploy tool's argument parser understands `--name value` but not `--name=value`, which is the form our scripts use. Add it: `--tag=` means an empty value, and `--=oops` is an error. The existing behaviour, including the bare `--` terminator, has to keep working. `go test ./...`.
notes: Needs the Go toolchain only. The largest edit in the corpus that is still a single hunk: a new branch inserted into a loop whose surrounding cases must be left alone. The terminator and lookahead tests catch a fix that reorders the loop's existing conditions.
